title: moltkia × intermedia
intro: Moltkia × intermedia, commonly known as Hybrid Moltkia, is a hybrid plant species that belongs to the borage family. This plant is used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and bronchodilatory effects. The therapeutic actions of Moltkia × intermedia include its ability to exert a sedative effect, relieve anxiety, and promote relaxation, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which have been found to possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
